        run: |
          python3 tests/datasets/test_build_hand_history_increment.py
          python3 tests/datasets/test_persisted_snapshot.py
      - name: Reproduce the 2026-09-09 Model A decision and overlay artifacts
        run: |
          python3 tools/training/build_incremental_decisions_v2.py \
            --source training/runs/20260909_population_increment_v2/source/RoiDePiqueNique_training2_delta_after_v4v5.zip \
            --out /tmp/poker_population_increment_decisions_v2.jsonl \
            --summary /tmp/model-a-0909-summary.json
          cmp /tmp/poker_population_increment_decisions_v2.jsonl \
            training/runs/20260909_population_increment_v2/data/poker_population_increment_decisions_v2.jsonl
          python3 tools/training/build_population_increment_overlay_v2.py \
            --decisions /tmp/poker_population_increment_decisions_v2.jsonl \
            --out /tmp/model-a-0909-overlay.json \
            --provenance-out /tmp/model-a-0909-overlay-provenance.json
          cmp /tmp/model-a-0909-overlay.json \
            training/runs/20260909_population_increment_v2/artifacts/poker_population_increment_overlay_v2.json
      - name: Rebuild and verify the persisted 2026-09-09 rejected postflop candidate
        run: |
          python3 tools/training/rebuild_postflop_increment_candidate.py \
            --baseline training/models/postflop_population_model_v5.json \
            --overlay /tmp/model-a-0909-overlay.json \
            --decisions /tmp/poker_population_increment_decisions_v2.jsonl \
            --date 2026-09-09 \
            --source-label RoiDePiqueNique_training2.zip \
            --lineage-fingerprint 809862c9090110dfecf6382492158fa585a905c3c5e1991daeb5199937643814 \
            --out /tmp/postflop-v6-rebuilt.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, math
          rebuilt=json.load(open('/tmp/postflop-v6-rebuilt.json'))
          persisted=json.load(open('training/runs/20260909_population_increment_v2/models/postflop_population_model_v6_candidate_REJECTED.json'))
          rn=rebuilt['nodes']; pn=persisted['nodes']
          key=lambda n:n.get('canonical_key') or n.get('id')
          assert len(rn)==len(pn)
          assert [key(n) for n in rn]==[key(n) for n in pn]
          for frozen in ('response_models','combo_policy_models','hand_policy_prior'):
              assert rebuilt.get(frozen)==persisted.get(frozen), frozen
          max_diff=0.0; changed=0
          for r,p in zip(rn,pn):
              k=key(r)
              for field in ('context','population_observed','coverage','rank_population'):
                  assert r.get(field)==p.get(field), (k,field)
              rm=r['population_model']; pm=p['population_model']
              assert rm.get('legal_actions')==pm.get('legal_actions'), k
              assert rm.get('method')==pm.get('method'), k
              assert set(rm['frequencies'])==set(pm['frequencies']), k
              for action,x in rm['frequencies'].items():
                  y=pm['frequencies'][action]; d=abs(float(x)-float(y)); max_diff=max(max_diff,d)
                  changed += int(d != 0.0)
                  assert math.isclose(float(x),float(y),rel_tol=0.0,abs_tol=1e-9), (k,action,x,y,d)
          assert rebuilt['coverage']==persisted['coverage']
          assert rebuilt['incremental_update']['train_population_rows_applied']==4651
          assert rebuilt['incremental_update']['train_population_rows_skipped_no_exact_node']==45
          assert rebuilt['incremental_update']['touched_nodes']==666
          print(json.dumps({'status':'SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT','nodes':len(rn),'changed_frequency_values':changed,'max_frequency_abs_diff':max_diff,'atol':1e-9},indent=2))
          PY
      - name: Rebuild the 2026-09-12 Model A normalized increment
        run: |
          python3 tools/training/build_incremental_decisions_v2.py \
            --source training/datasets/NLHE_100-200/increments/20260912/source/selected_100_200.zip \
            --out /tmp/model-a-0912-decisions.jsonl \
            --summary /tmp/model-a-0912-summary.json
          python3 tools/training/build_population_increment_overlay_v2.py \
            --decisions /tmp/model-a-0912-decisions.jsonl \
            --out /tmp/model-a-0912-overlay.json \
            --provenance-out /tmp/model-a-0912-overlay-provenance.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import collections, json
          summary=json.load(open('/tmp/model-a-0912-summary.json'))
          assert summary['source_unique_hands']==3268, summary
          assert summary['parsed_hands']==3268, summary
          assert summary['source_hand_ids_fingerprint_sha256']=='9eb753baed592b48d697ad6d00652612de6153e5033448f41983bccc9e31be2b'
          assert summary['hands_by_split']=={'TRAIN':2606,'VALIDATION':320,'TEST':342}, summary['hands_by_split']
          assert summary['rows_total']==42964, summary['rows_total']
          counts=collections.Counter()
          with open('/tmp/model-a-0912-decisions.jsonl') as f:
              for line in f:
                  row=json.loads(line)
                  if row['split']=='TRAIN' and not row['is_hero']:
                      counts[row['street'] if row['street']=='preflop' else 'postflop'] += 1
          assert counts['preflop']==13774, counts
          assert counts['postflop']==15962, counts
          overlay=json.load(open('/tmp/model-a-0912-overlay.json'))
          assert overlay['summary']['train_population_rows']==29736, overlay['summary']
          print(json.dumps({'summary':summary,'train_population_rows':dict(counts)}, indent=2))
          PY
      - name: Rebuild the 2026-09-12 preflop full-weight candidate
        run: |
          python3 tools/training/rebuild_preflop_increment_candidate.py \
            --baseline training/models/preflop_population_model_v5.json \
            --overlay /tmp/model-a-0912-overlay.json \
            --decisions /tmp/model-a-0912-decisions.jsonl \
            --date 2026-09-12 \
            --source-label selected_100_200.zip \
            --lineage-fingerprint 9eb753baed592b48d697ad6d00652612de6153e5033448f41983bccc9e31be2b \
            --out /tmp/model-a-0912-preflop-candidate.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json
          base=json.load(open('training/models/preflop_population_model_v5.json'))
          manifest=json.load(open('training/runs/20260912_population_increment_cycle/evaluation/model_a_candidate_rebuild_manifest.json'))
          obj=json.load(open('/tmp/model-a-0912-preflop-candidate.json'))
          inc=obj['incremental_update']
          assert inc['train_population_rows_applied']==9047, inc
          assert inc['train_population_rows_skipped_no_exact_node']==4727, inc
          assert inc['touched_nodes']==108, inc
          assert inc['alpha_exact']==40, inc
          assert obj.get('response_models')==base.get('response_models')
          assert obj.get('revealed_policy_models')==base.get('revealed_policy_models')
          assert obj.get('hand_grid')==base.get('hand_grid')
          key=lambda n:n.get('canonical_key') or n.get('id')
          bm={key(n):n for n in base['nodes']}; cm={key(n):n for n in obj['nodes']}
          assert set(bm)==set(cm)
          for k,b in bm.items():
              c=cm[k]
              assert c.get('context')==b.get('context'), k
              assert c.get('continuous_population')==b.get('continuous_population'), k
              for field in ('policy169_q_b64','response_model_key','continuous_adjustment','legal_actions'):
                  assert (c.get('population_model') or {}).get(field)==(b.get('population_model') or {}).get(field), (k,field)
          semantic={
              'nodes':obj['nodes'],'coverage':obj['coverage'],'hand_grid':obj.get('hand_grid'),
              'response_models':obj.get('response_models'),'revealed_policy_models':obj.get('revealed_policy_models'),
          }
          semantic_sha=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(semantic,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
          assert semantic_sha==manifest['preflop']['semantic_sha256'], (semantic_sha,manifest['preflop']['semantic_sha256'])
          print(json.dumps({
              'status':'REBUILT','byte_sha256':hashlib.sha256(open('/tmp/model-a-0912-preflop-candidate.json','rb').read()).hexdigest(),
              'semantic_sha256':semantic_sha,
              'historical_local_sha256_not_persisted':manifest['preflop']['historical_local_sha256_not_persisted'],
              'incremental_update':inc},indent=2))
          PY
      - name: Rebuild the 2026-09-12 postflop full-weight candidate
        run: |
          python3 tools/training/rebuild_postflop_increment_candidate.py \
            --baseline training/models/postflop_population_model_v5.json \
            --overlay /tmp/model-a-0912-overlay.json \
            --decisions /tmp/model-a-0912-decisions.jsonl \
            --date 2026-09-12 \
            --source-label selected_100_200.zip \
            --lineage-fingerprint 9eb753baed592b48d697ad6d00652612de6153e5033448f41983bccc9e31be2b \
            --model-version postflop_v6_20260912_full_weight_REJECTED \
            --out /tmp/model-a-0912-postflop-candidate.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json
          p='/tmp/model-a-0912-postflop-candidate.json'
          manifest=json.load(open('training/runs/20260912_population_increment_cycle/evaluation/model_a_candidate_rebuild_manifest.json'))
          obj=json.load(open(p))
          inc=obj['incremental_update']
          assert inc['train_population_rows_applied']==15804, inc
          assert inc['train_population_rows_skipped_no_exact_node']==158, inc
          assert inc['touched_nodes']==1116, inc
          semantic={
              'nodes':obj['nodes'],
              'coverage':obj['coverage'],
              'response_models':obj.get('response_models'),
              'combo_policy_models':obj.get('combo_policy_models'),
              'hand_policy_prior':obj.get('hand_policy_prior'),
          }
          semantic_sha=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(semantic,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
          byte_sha=hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
          assert semantic_sha==manifest['postflop']['semantic_sha256'], (semantic_sha,manifest['postflop']['semantic_sha256'])
          assert byte_sha==manifest['postflop']['generated_byte_sha256'], (byte_sha,manifest['postflop']['generated_byte_sha256'])
          print(json.dumps({'status':'REBUILT','byte_sha256':byte_sha,'semantic_sha256':semantic_sha,'historical_local_sha256_not_persisted':manifest['postflop']['historical_local_sha256_not_persisted'],'incremental_update':inc},indent=2))
          PY

            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --name model-b-card-aware-v1-b71c3bc6dca7875b333eb9fbfa72eb6e4cd7d2a4 \

            --count 4 \
            --reps 1 \
            --seed 20260915 \
            --output /tmp/full-hand-model-b-smoke.json

          python3 - <<'PY'

          from pathlib import Path

          assert report['schema'] == 'full-hand-model-b-benchmark/v1'
          assert report['population_id'] == 'pokerstars_nlhe_100-200_zoom_play_6max_v1'
          assert report['model_b']['selection_decision'] == 'RETAIN_PUBLIC_ONLY_REFERENCE_FOR_BEHAVIOR_COMPONENT'
          assert report['model_b']['artifact_sha256'] == 'fc54f874220fdd8ec42ad69c3eff4d3235296f15f7e22ca4a5bb1837b97636ca'
          assert report['model_b']['test_consumed_by_issue_104'] is False
          assert report['summary']['simulated_hands'] == 4
          assert report['summary']['independent_hands'] == 4
          source = report['scenario_manifest']['source']
          assert source['selection_contract'] == 'certified-predeal-table-geometry-only'
          assert source['certification']['population_fingerprint_sha256'] == '4661c200fab5a24ce67a45f0801acd0238c701f55e8dbeeaf3e8299fa250119c'

          assert all('detached public state' in row['trust_contract'] for row in report['results'])
          print(json.dumps(report['summary'], indent=2, sort_keys=True))
          PY

          name: issue-105-retained-model-b-smoke-${{ github.sha }}
